user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing; sites opted out will not appear in ChatGPT search answers

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; landing page safety validation and relevance determination

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Make generative AI foundation models more useful and safe through training data collection
user_agents.scope: Automatic crawl of content for training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: GPTBot / Disallow: / to indicate content should not be used in training

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs when users ask questions or interact
user_agents.scope: User-initiated fetch for live responses; not automatic web crawling; robots.txt may not apply

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect web content for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for model training datasets
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; also supports Crawl-delay directive

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-initiated web requests when Claude AI users ask questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch to retrieve content in response to user queries

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search result quality by analyzing online content
user_agents.scope: Web crawl to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses

user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Google Search, Images, Video, News, Discover, and related features

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawling images for Google's image search and related products
user_agents.scope: Image URLs for Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image features

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawling videos for Google's video search features
user_agents.scope: Video-related content for Google Search and video-dependent products

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawling content for Google News product and news.google.com
user_agents.scope: News content for Google News product and Google News app

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool

user_agents.scope: Content fetching for Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console only

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for various Google product teams and research
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content fetching for internal R&D and various product-specific needs

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image crawling for Google products optimized for image URLs
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs for various Google internal uses

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video

user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs for various Google internal uses

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot

user_agents.scope: Content from sites for Gemini model training and Search index grounding; no impact on Google Search ranking

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in search results on Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Search index updates; not used for AI foundation model training
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: PerplexityBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions within Perplexity for fetching web pages to answer user questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses; not used for web crawling or training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: Configure IP-based blocking or User-Agent filtering; generally ignores robots.txt as user-requested

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Power search technology integrated into Spotlight, Siri, and Safari
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing across Apple ecosystem

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determine if crawled content can be used to train Apple foundation models for generative AI
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; processes data from Applebot crawls for AI training eligibility
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Applebot-Extended / Disallow: / in robots.txt to opt-out from AI training use

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawl URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: Apple Podcasts content only; does not follow robots.txt directives

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit

user_agents.scope: Content shared on Meta family apps (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger); may bypass robots.txt for security checks
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule for facebookexternalhit in robots.txt; may bypass for security/integrity checks

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality and relevance through web indexing
user_agents.scope: Web crawl to enhance Meta AI search results and citation accuracy
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule for meta-webindexer in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and business-related products and services
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for advertising optimization and related business use cases
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule for meta-externalads in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models and improve products through content indexing
user_agents.scope: Direct content indexing for AI training and product improvement
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule for meta-externalagent in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches for AI navigation and task completion; may bypass robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule for meta-externalfetcher in robots.txt; may bypass for user-requested tasks

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for OpenAI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Bing search engine indexing
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search results

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services, train Amazon AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for product improvement and generative AI training
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Amazonbot / Disallow: / in robots.txt, or page-level robots meta noarchive tag

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services
user_agents.scope: Crawl for search indexing in Alexa and Rufus; does not train generative AI models

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-triggered actions like responding to Alexa queries with up-to-date information
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live information; does not crawl for generative AI model training

user_agents.name: CCBot/2.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for creating an internet dataset for research and analysis
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, samples of websites rather than complete archives
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt Disallow / for user-agent CCBot; supports Crawl-delay parameter

user_agents.name: CCBot/1.0
user_agents.purpose: Legacy web crawling for creating an internet dataset for research and analysis
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, samples of websites rather than complete archives
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt Disallow / for user-agent CCBot; supports Crawl-delay parameter

user_agents.name: Agentic crawlers (general category)
user_agents.purpose: Autonomous AI agents collecting data for training and production use
user_agents.scope: General web crawl traffic; agentic actors represent ~10% of total requests as of March 2026
user_agents.opt_out: Redirects for AI Training feature and Pay-Per-Crawl (HTTP 402) allow publishers to redirect or monetize crawler access

user_agents.name: AI Training crawlers
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for large language models and AI systems
user_agents.scope: Crawls content to build training datasets; subject to Redirects for AI Training mechanism
user_agents.opt_out: Publishers can use Redirects for AI Training to enforce canonical content by redirecting verified crawlers to preferred pages

user_agents.name: Malicious bots
user_agents.purpose: Content scraping, login attacks, fraud, and other malicious activities
user_agents.scope: Mimics human behavior; represents significant portion of automated traffic alongside legitimate AI bots
user_agents.opt_out: Bot management and application security controls required; no specific opt-out mechanism documented
